name: print-social-carousel-purple-metaverse-vr-model-photo
title: Purple 'Enter the Metaverse' carousel with VR model photography
whatItIs: A nine-tile Instagram grid on a deep purple background, using duotone-purple photography of a person wearing a VR headset alongside bold headline tiles like 'ENTER THE METAVERSE' and 'THE FUTURE'.
whatItMeans: Duotoning real photography into the brand's exact purple keeps photo tiles from clashing with the flat typographic tiles around them in the same grid.
techniques: duotone photography into the exact brand accent color so photo and flat tiles blend seamlessly
repeat one strong lead phrase (metaverse/future) across multiple tiles for message reinforcement
frame the cover tile with a bold left-aligned headline for a strong grid-view first impression

vocabulary.definition: photography color-graded into two tones, typically to match a strict brand palette
